This nonzero mathematical error is separate from bit-identical rounded output agreement. CPU-only oracle never uploaded.

raw_event.cause: Native original FP32 MILC_COMPLEX k_mat_nn and its source grid retained unchanged. Historical Julia performs genuine complex products but stores split-real/imaginary SoA; restoring actual 320-byte site AoS is P1 mapping alignment, not S1 missing mathematics. Source compiled CPU ABI/initializer witness verifies 16-byte alignment, matrix72B, site80 UInt32 words, links72 Float32 words and metadata offsets. Raw UInt32 field storage/reinterpret Float32 in Julia preserves every input/output/metadata/guard bit without CUDA device extensions.
